[[General/Legends|General]] '''Kendu Ultho''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;which had been defeated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash;against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. During the [[Western Reaches Operation]], a campaign of the Imperial [[Reconquest of the Rim]] that sought to pacify criminal elements and Separatist holdouts in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Ultho and his forces joined with [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lord/Legends|lord]] [[Guun Cutlax]] of the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] in the<ref name="Warfare" /> Outer Rim's<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]. Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Ultho was [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Battle of Ogoth Tiir/Legends|fighting]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] at the Outer Rim astronomical object [[Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Ogoth Tiir]], a battle that saw the capture of his forces as well as the end of the Reconquest of the Rim.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kendu Ultho was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
